Cabrera maintained the conclusion despite the absence of written contracts or subscription agreements directly documenting the alleged stake.

stories.title: Sara Duterte Trial Day 39: Court to finalize admin matters before break
stories.summary: On day 39 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial, the Philippine Senate impeachment court is set to address administrative matters before its break. The court is finalizing an order governing confidential documents included in the prosecution’s formal offer of evidence, according to presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero.

stories.title: Rwanda-Backed Rebels Enter Congo's Safe-Haven City
stories.summary: Rwanda-backed rebels entered Goma after overrunning Congolese troops, with residents reporting gunfire and shelling. United Nations officials estimated that more than one million displaced people were inside the city.

stories.title: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
stories.summary: A former Plaud executive has raised $26 million for an AI app designed to listen in the background and gather personal context. TechCrunch describes constant listening, watching or recording as a way such products collect the context used to make suggestions.

links.headline: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
links.excerpt: One of the core promises of AI is that the more it knows about a person, the better it will be able to assist them with tasks and make appropriate suggestions, which, if you'll believe the tech companies, requires apps and devices to listen, watch, or record users' activity all the time and gather all possible context.
